item.description: Demo data - ready-to-run sample requests with realistic payloads and saved example responses (demo IDs, sample work orders, contact messages, etc.). Use these to explore the API without building bodies from scratch. Variables such as {{categoryId}}, {{vendorId}}, {{technicianId}}, {{workOrderId}} and {{paymentId}} must still be filled from a previous request's response.
